answer: Each identity locks 80 credits and posts one bridge quote pair, each side funded with 40 credits bound to its key. Fees rise with canyon depth: first pair 20, kth 20+5(k-1), 1,000th 5,015, so 1,000 fakes pay 2,517,500 plus 80,000 locked. The book is public; an auditor checks at two checkpoints that both stay funded, and an echo seal binding key and margin exposes reuse: a missing quote or reused margin burns the bond. A rented-quote ring fails: one funding signature on two pairs burns both. An honest agent pays 20 once and recovers the 80 after a clean epoch.
